extraction: Unmodified upstream release tarball of the galstreams package, tag v1.2.1 (published 2026-06-03T17:20:14Z per the GitHub releases API). Contains 437 track ECSV data files plus the master_log. ONLY data files were read; no code from this archive was imported or executed.
measurement_or_model: MIXED - see galstreams_track_summary.tsv for a per-track label.
note: galstreams: Mateu 2023, MNRAS 520, 5225 (doi:10.1093/mnras/stad321), arXiv:2204.10326. Repo github.com/cmateu/galstreams. The published paper describes v1.0 (126 tracks / 95 streams); this tag v1.2.1 ships 217 tracks.
